diaspora_bullets: No country quota: Indian applicants compete in one global pool of 150,000 places
The cap counts new arrivals only, not study permit extensions or post-graduation work permits
hook_line: CANADA HOLDS NEW STUDENT ARRIVALS AT 150,000 A YEAR THROUGH 2029

hook_stat.sub: New student arrivals Canada allows each year through 2029

news_summary: Canada's 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan holds new international student arrivals at up to 150,000 a year, inside a 370,000 temporary-resident ceiling, with no country quotas.
payoff: Families weighing Canada against other destinations should plan on the capped regime lasting through 2029.

stats.label: Ceiling on new temporary resident arrivals a year, including 220,000 workers
Student arrivals target set for 2025, before the climb-down
Permanent resident admissions held steady each year
